name: Off-Roading Epic
desc:
Welcome to one of the most unique vehicle simulations on Roblox. Tired of driving the same few vehicles in every game? Then check out Off-Roading Epic!

🗻❄Hit the town, trails, roads, mud, ice and roleplay in over 180 of the biggest, smallest, weirdest, coolest and most unique vehicles on Roblox!

🚛🚚Drive your very own big rig, road-train, overland train, and so much more with one of over 60 different oversized, tanker, logging, flat, cattle, shipping container, box, telescopic and dump truck trailers.

⛄🌨Grab your favorite snow cruiser and start your journey to the arctic circle!

👨‍🌾 Plow, plant, grow and harvest your very own crops on the farmer job! You can also cut, rake and bale your own hay!

🚗🚜Here's some of the vehicle types you'll find here: Semi trucks, dune buggies, swamp buggies, cars, buses, tractors, combine harvester, pickups, micro-cars, monster trucks, dirt bike and more!
